title: ng2-pdfjs-viewer: an Angular component library for embedding and controlling Mozilla PDF.js
description:
An Angular component library that wraps Mozilla PDF.js in a single <ng2-pdfjs-viewer> element, exposing viewing, printing, annotation, zoom, search, theming and accessibility through a declarative input and event surface. It ships a modified PDF.js viewer with its own event protocol, a headless signals store, and a bring-your-own-model AI entry point that requires no backend service.

Published on npm as ng2-pdfjs-viewer. Documentation at https://angularpdf.com.
